title: DVB-T2 typestate builder preset for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Implement the typestate fluent builder for the DVB-T2 BICM AWGN
preset, exposing the API surface designed in Phase 0 design doc §9
(typestate builder example). The preset reuses
`gf2_coding::ldpc::dvb_t2::concat::DvbT2Concat` as the underlying
codec; the typestate machinery enforces stage-order correctness at
compile time.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §9 (layered API surfaces),
§1 (module skeleton — owns `crates/gf2-sim/src/presets/`), §12
(migration plan). Wave A.2 fan-out from `118a0091`; no inter-A.2 deps.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/presets/dvb_t2.rs` containing:
   - Typestate marker types: `NeedsModcod`, `NeedsDecoder`,
     `NeedsDemap`, `NeedsChannel`, `Ready`.
   - `Pipeline::dvb_t2() -> Builder<NeedsModcod>` entry point.
   - Builder methods that consume and return a new typestate-tagged
     `Builder<NextState>`: `.modcod()`, `.decoder()`, `.demap()`,
     `.channel()`, `.parallelism()`, `.seed()`, `.checkpoint_dir()`.
   - `Builder<Ready>::build() -> Result<Pipeline, BuildError>`.
   - Internally the builder constructs a graph (see `c09d3e95`)
     wired with the standard DVB-T2 BICM stages:
     `BchEncoder → LdpcEncoder → BitInterleaver → GrayQam → Channel
     → GrayQamDemapper → BitDeinterleaver → LdpcDecoder → BchDecoder`.
2. The preset wraps `gf2_coding::ldpc::dvb_t2::concat::DvbT2Concat`
   (the bit-exact end-to-end DVB-T2 codec already validated by
   `4cdaf1c5`) for the BCH + LDPC + interleaver path. The Stage
   wrappers around `DvbT2Concat` live in
   `crates/gf2-sim/src/presets/dvb_t2/stages.rs`.
3. Standard 6-MODCOD pre-wired Modcod enum:
   `Modcod::Normal { rate: Rate, modulation: Mod }` with
   `rate ∈ {R1_2, R2_3, R3_4}`, `modulation ∈ {Qam16, Qam64}`.
4. Doc-comment example in the rustdoc of `Pipeline::dvb_t2()`
   showing the full builder chain producing a working pipeline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] DVB-T2 BICM chain expressible via the typestate builder
  for all 6 in-scope MODCODs; example in rustdoc compiles and
  runs (doctest passes under `cargo test --doc -p gf2-sim`).
- [hard] Wrong stage ordering yields a compile-time error: a test
  in `tests/compile_fail/` (e.g., `trybuild`-style) verifies that
  `.decoder()` cannot be called before `.modcod()`.
- [hard] Builder output is identical to a hand-wired graph API
  chain (see `c09d3e95`) for the same `(rate, modulation, decoder,
  demap, seed)` tuple — a round-trip test in `tests/preset_vs_graph.rs`
  asserts byte-identity of the output `Pipeline` execution for a
  fixed input batch.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No graph API implementation (owned by `c09d3e95`); this task
  USES the graph API once `c09d3e95` lands but does not depend on
  its completion — initial typestate stubs may emit a stub graph
  that the `c09d3e95` deliverable later replaces.
- No 5G NR preset (owned by `e478daa8`).
- No GPU stage variants in the preset (`bbf6b6ee` rewires `--gpu`).
